findings.description: Coverage: the department faculty-staff page yielded 58 person cards (37 Faculty, 13 Emeriti, 8 Staff). The campus directory for department 50001063 yielded 131 cards; the brief scope (68 entries) is covered by the 58 faculty-page cards and the directory cards for the directory-only entries and the alias-merged directory titles. Every faculty-page card and every directory card that matches the title filter (53) or the three special names (Jerry Hudgins, Lance Perez, James Stine) is in the brief. No omissions. Both lists were fully enumerated (complete = true).

Same-person pair still listed as two brief entries, decided identically: "Dr. Fred Choobineh, Ph.D., P.E." (faculty page, 8ab0cb, "Blackman Distinguished Professor Emeritus", Emeriti heading) and "F Choobineh" (directory, ab972b, "Emeritus Professor"; uid fchoobineh1). Both emeritus, excluded, past, membership ece.

Same-person pairs merged by the collector through the alias list (one brief entry each, decided once): Eva Franke-Schubert / Eva Schubert; M. R. Hasan / Mohammad Rashedul Hasan; Won Mee Jang / Won Jang; Hamid Sharif / Hamid Sharif-Kashani; Yanan (Laura) Wang / Laura Wang; Lamar Yaoqing Yang / LaMar Yang; P. Frazer Williams / Paul Williams. For each, both the faculty-page card and the directory card were checked and their titles agree in decision.

Fadi Alsaleem (directory only, "Associate Professor" for ECE department 50001063). His directory profile (retrieved 2026-11-25T02:31:26+00:00) lists "Courtesy Associate Professor - Electrical & Computer Engineering", an explicit courtesy designation, alongside a primary appointment in the Durham School. Included as courtesy, membership ece, current. Would change to excluded only if the ECE courtesy appointment were withdrawn.

Lance C. Perez / Lance Perez: faculty page "Fred Hunzeker Dean of Engineering and Omar H. Heins Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering"; directory "Dean". The official department page states an ECE professorial (named chair) appointment, so the dean rule is met. Included as regular, current.

Jerry L. Hudgins: faculty page "Professor, Interim Executive Director of Raikes School" under Faculty; directory "Interim Executive Director". Professorial rank on the main faculty list; included as regular, current.

James Stine: faculty page "Department Chair, Jim and Gail Anderson Professor of Engineering"; directory "Chairperson". Chair with professorial rank on the main faculty list: regular, included, current.

David Hansen (directory only): "Affiliate - Dr. Bhardwaj" in Electrical & Computer Engineering; profile tag "affiliate", no professorial rank. Not affiliate_professor; excluded as affiliate, not_in_core. Would change to affiliate_professor only if a professorial affiliate rank were stated.
Khalid Sayood: "Emeritus Professor" on the faculty page (Emeriti heading); directory "Adjunct Professor". Both are excluded categories; decided as emeritus (past), the primary role.
Roger Sash: faculty-page title is blank, listed under the Emeriti heading. Decided as emeritus (past) by the heading; excluded. No directory listing.
Paul Snyder: faculty-page title is blank, listed under the Emeriti heading. Decided as emeritus (past) by the heading; excluded. No directory listing.
Matthew Boeding (directory only): "Lecturer/T", teaching track, excluded as teaching, not_in_core.

William Brogan (directory only, "Emeritus Professor") and Alfred Witte Jr (directory only, "Emeritus Associate Professor") are on the campus directory but not on the faculty page; decided as emeritus, past, excluded.
Michael Hempel ("Research Associate Professor"), Xi Huang, Graham Kaufman and Ufuk Kilic ("Research Assistant Professor") are research professor-track titles: excluded as research_only, not_in_core.

Witty Srisa-an is not in the brief and not on the faculty page or campus directory list 50001063, so no record is written. The graduate faculty directory (https://engineering.unl.edu/graduate-programs/about/faculty-directory/, retrieved 2026-11-25T02:31:26+00:00, sha256 82b543f9bf5f1d0ddf0faa8314ace84e5851276f18fd467fb6e9ce94c1c4f88d) lists him as "Director, School of Computing / Interim Chair, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering". That is an administrative ECE title with no professorial ECE appointment stated, and the ECE department pages do not list him as faculty. It does not clearly establish current ECE professorial membership, so it is not reported as an omission.

Staff: eight people on the faculty page under the Staff heading (Dohe, Esau, Franta, Lahti, Rutar, Ryans, Townsend, Wiebe) are excluded as non-faculty staff (academic_professional, not_in_core). Membership recorded as ece because they are listed on the ECE department page.
Professors of Practice (Bauer, Gilmore, Harms, McCreight) are excluded as academic_professional per project convention.
